name: unc-libcal-mcp
description: Book UNC Davis Library study rooms and cubicles from your AI assistant.
long_description:
MCP server for booking [UNC Davis Library](https://calendar.lib.unc.edu) study spaces.

**Before booking:** run the login helper once from a terminal to save your Onyen session to `~/.unc-libcal/`:

```bash
cd <install-dir> && node dist/login.js
```

Then use `libcal_auth_status` to confirm the session is valid.

Built for UNC students, faculty, and staff. Not affiliated with or endorsed by UNC Libraries.

tools.name: libcal_auth_status
tools.description: Check whether the saved UNC LibCal Onyen session is valid.

tools.name: libcal_suggest
tools.description: Find the best booking plan across cubes, piecemeal slots, and alternate times.

tools.name: libcal_analyze_window
tools.description: Analyze availability for a specific time window without booking.

tools.name: libcal_check_availability
tools.description: List available spaces for a date, time, and duration.

tools.name: libcal_book
tools.description: Book a single contiguous study space after the user confirms.

tools.name: libcal_book_piecemeal
tools.description: Book multiple back-to-back segments when no single cube fits.

tools.name: libcal_list_calendars
tools.description: List Apple Calendar calendars for optional event creation.
